# Notice

This project is a modern Fortran translation of the computational code in the
R package `zigg` 0.0.2 by Dirk Eddelbuettel.

Upstream states that its Ziggurat implementation builds on the Marsaglia and
Tsang (2000) algorithm, the Leong, Zhang et al. (2005) correction, work by John
Burkardt, and the RcppZiggurat package.  See
`upstream/inst/include/zigg/header` for the original copyright and detailed
attribution comments.
